applies.heading: Where It Applies
applies.sub: Four deployments, each reading the device for a different decision.
gap.heading:
Identities are cheap.
Devices are not.
gap.sub: A fraudster can acquire hundreds of stolen identities for a few thousand rupees each. A fraudster cannot acquire hundreds of phones. The device is the one asset in the fraud chain that does not scale cheaply. Device Intelligence reads it as the ground truth for identity, producing a persistent fingerprint alongside a real-time assessment of whether the device, the network, and the session are genuine.
hero.heading: A continuous read on the Device behind every customer interaction.
hero.sub: An SDK that reads the device at the point of interaction and returns a comprehensive risk assessment: persistent device identity, integrity evaluation, remote-access detection, network and location analysis, and installed-application profiling. Real-time, per session.

reader.heading: What Device Intelligence Reads
reader.slides[0].body: Every other identifier can be changed. The device cannot be cheaply replaced. Device Intelligence generates a unique fingerprint from hardware-level signals that persists when everything else has been wiped or manipulated.
reader.slides[0].cards[0].label: Device ID
reader.slides[0].cards[1].label: Persistence
reader.slides[0].cards[2].label: Linked accounts
reader.slides[0].cards[3].label: Device age
reader.slides[0].points:
Stable across factory resets, reinstallations, and identifier changes
Recognises the same device across sessions, accounts, and applications
Multi-account linkage: all identities associated with a single device surfaced
Historical device risk carried forward across the device's full lifecycle
reader.slides[0].title: Device Identity and Persistence
reader.slides[1].body: A manipulated device environment is one of the strongest indicators that the session is not genuine. This cluster evaluates whether the device and application are operating in a trustworthy state.
reader.slides[1].cards[0].label: Root / jailbreak
reader.slides[1].cards[1].label: Emulator
reader.slides[1].cards[2].label: App cloning
reader.slides[1].cards[3].label: Install source
reader.slides[1].cards[4].label: RASP
reader.slides[1].points:
Root, jailbreak, and emulator detection
App cloning, hooking frameworks, and unauthorised modifications
Installation source verification
Keylogger and harmful application detection
Runtime application self-protection (RASP): tamper, hook, and manipulation assessment
reader.slides[1].title: App and Device Integrity
reader.slides[2].body: In authorised-push-payment scams, the victim’s own device is used against them, controlled remotely while the fraudster guides the transaction by phone. This cluster identifies sessions where the device is under external control.
reader.slides[2].cards[0].label: Remote-access apps
reader.slides[2].cards[1].label: Screen mirroring
reader.slides[2].cards[2].label: Accessibility abuse
reader.slides[2].cards[3].label: Interaction
reader.slides[2].points:
Remote-access application detection (presence and count)
Active screen mirroring identification
Accessibility-service abuse detection
Indicators of coached or externally directed interaction
reader.slides[2].title: Remote Access and Session Threats
reader.slides[3].body: The network context of a session reveals what the device’s own identifiers may conceal. In the Indian market, where CGNAT renders IP-based signals unreliable across most mobile networks, this layer provides a materially more reliable read.
reader.slides[3].cards[0].label: VPN / proxy
reader.slides[3].cards[1].label: GPS spoofing
reader.slides[3].cards[2].label: ISP
reader.slides[3].cards[3].label: SIM
reader.slides[3].points:
VPN, proxy, and unsecured network detection
GPS spoofing identification
IP-level intelligence: geolocation, ISP, ASN, fraud score
SIM data: count, swap history, eSIM detection, carrier
reader.slides[3].title: Network and Location Intelligence
reader.slides[4].body: The applications installed on a device carry risk, affluence, and behavioural signals that no document or bureau score contains. This cluster reads the app portfolio and derives category-level intelligence from it.
reader.slides[4].cards[0].label: Lending apps
reader.slides[4].cards[1].label: Finance affinity
reader.slides[4].cards[2].label: Premium apps
reader.slides[4].cards[3].label: Gaming affinity
reader.slides[4].points:
Category-level affinity scores: lending, finance, gaming, entertainment, productivity
Lending application density as a credit-seeking signal
Premium application presence as an affluence indicator
reader.slides[4].title: Appographic Intelligence
reader.sub: One SDK call. Every layer of the device read in parallel — identity, integrity, control, connection, and what the device reveals about the person holding it.
